message: The other night, we had a little scare with a storm warning, and my family group chat lit up like a Christmas tree! 🌩️ Between the jokes about my ‘emergency snack stash’ and reminders to grab our go-bags, it turned into a hilarious bonding moment. It’s funny how a little panic can bring everyone together, but it also reminded me of the importance of being ready. How does your family stay connected during unexpected moments?
